title: Ropetrick

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
This spell was used by Eathon Lambert to help Simon Judeau save Metz from falling into a pool of liquid hot magma. [The Divine Comedy]

His son, Lok Lambert used this to distract an Enforcer [The Golden Asp]

Dante Vale used Ropetrick in for Solwing to tie up a group of defeated Silent Soldiers. [Sophie on Trial]

Lok later used the spell to tie up Wind in the Phoenix Volcano. [The Phoenix's Ashes].

full_text:
Ropetrick is a spell used to manipulate pieces of rope and is manifested through a yellow aura. This spell is highly versatile and can be used for tying knots, binding enemies, or saving falling allies.

== History ==
This spell was used by Eathon Lambert to help Simon Judeau save Metz from falling into a pool of liquid hot magma. [The Divine Comedy]

His son, Lok Lambert used this to distract an Enforcer [The Golden Asp]

Dante Vale used Ropetrick in for Solwing to tie up a group of defeated Silent Soldiers. [Sophie on Trial]

Lok later used the spell to tie up Wind in the Phoenix Volcano. [The Phoenix's Ashes].
